goal: Validate a v3 candidate policy before manual compatibility review.
when_to_use: Use before replacing a v3 policy in a consumer or release branch while native v3 compat/inspect commands are still future work.
commands: go run ./cmd/cervorules-policygen check -vocab policy-vocabulary.yaml -policy policy-rules.candidate.yaml -format json
failure_mode: Fail the task when validation fails or the manual diff shows an unaccepted behavioral change.
notes: Attach validation JSON and the policy diff to the issue or PR.
Use cervantesh/cervo-rules-v2 only for historical v2 migration/diff tooling.
